newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures hold huge gains late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures hold huge gains late.

text.p: July 22 - U.S. stock index futures expanded hefty gains, boosted by rally, strong close in T-bond futures. Sept S&P 500s rallied on heavy dealer, fund buying, hit big buystops in busy trade. Some brokers now target front-month contract high at 946.75. Greenspan said Fed eventually may need to change rates, that for now demand growth has moderated.
